title: Answer: no account of life, though biological networks show more causal emergence

statements.text: Causal emergence takes no position on what life is. What its sources say about living systems is a measured difference: biological networks show a greater propensity for causal emergence than technological ones, and more than comparable social networks. Biological systems are cryptic in this sense, since their intrinsic functional scale is a macroscale that is hard to discover, which makes them more robust to failure and harder to control from outside.
statements.scope: The emergence of informative higher scales in complex networks (2020) and Emergence as the conversion of information (2021)

sources.quote: we observe a significantly greater propensity for causal emergence in biological networks
